subject.title: fix(agents): tighten lsSchema.limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer

question: Should the built-in `ls` tool intentionally reject fractional `limit` values at the schema boundary instead of preserving the existing numeric input contract and runtime normalization?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically possible; selecting strict rejection changes accepted tool-call input and therefore requires ownership intent rather than an automated compatibility assumption.

options.title: Accept integer-only input
options.body: Approve the stricter schema, refresh the branch, and merge once required guards pass on the exact head.

options.title: Preserve numeric compatibility
options.body: Keep `Type.Number` and close or revise this PR if fractional values should continue reaching normalization logic.

recommendation.title: Accept integer-only input
recommendation.body: Approve the stricter schema, refresh the branch, and merge once required guards pass on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has recent adjacent agent-runtime and input-validation history and is the strongest available owner for the compatibility choice.
